subject: Submodular status: enron replication done, influence-max 20x slower
body:
Hi Bruno,

Replication is done. On the enron graph we match the paper's oracle-call counts exactly — the cross-platform-deterministic randomness makes this satisfying to verify — and the dynamic algorithm tracks the greedy baseline's objective within 5% across cardinality constraints k from 10 to 100, at a fraction of the oracle calls in the sliding-window setting.

The internal port is where the risk sits: the influence-maximization oracle is roughly 20x slower than plain coverage on our graph because of the sampling requirement. Coverage-only gets us the freshness win we actually care about for retrieval.

Recommendation: drop influence maximization from Q3 scope and keep it as a research thread.

Csilla
